import bpy
from pathlib import Path
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
current=bpy.data.collections['Harbor_Arrival_Landing'].objects['LandingDeck']
backup=ns['root']/'captures/surface_before_20261109_213235/harbor_coast_mcp.blend'
with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(backup),link=False) as (src,dst):
    assert 'LandingDeck' in src.objects, 'Backup has no LandingDeck'
    dst.objects=['LandingDeck']
loaded=next(o for o in dst.objects if o is not None)
print('LANDING_BACKUP_MESH',len(loaded.data.vertices),len(loaded.data.polygons))
mats=list(current.data.materials)
old=current.data
current.data=loaded.data.copy()
current.data.materials.clear()
for m in mats:current.data.materials.append(m)
bpy.data.objects.remove(loaded,do_unlink=True)
if old.users==0:bpy.data.meshes.remove(old)
current['natural_surface_wear']=False
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
print('LANDING_RESTORED',len(current.data.vertices),len(current.data.polygons))
